svg.title: The model lifecycle on watsonx.ai
svg.desc: The model lifecycle on one line: build, deploy, monitor and retrain, and back again. IBM says watsonx.ai runs validated models on supported infrastructure, serves AI to your applications and agents, and manages each model from development to monitoring and retraining, with open-source, low-code or pro-code tools.
